title: Cap. IX Arg. 14 Sol close: elect praxis — saints more studious of piety the more certain of election (patriarchs, Mary, apostles; 1 John iii. 3); profane presume and grow less careful, pious burn hotter
pass_a_gloss: Finally the praxis of all the saints cries out against Arminius, whom it is certain were so much the more studious of piety and of true obedience, the more certain they were of their election and of everlasting life. Example can be the holy Patriarchs, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, the most Blessed of women the Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, Peter, Paul, and the remaining Apostles: Nay every one who has this hope in himself sanctifies himself, even as he is holy, 1 Joann. iii. 3. Profane men therefore, who are wont foolishly to presume, and idly to chatter of their predestination, are thence rendered less solicitous concerning worshipping God: but the breasts of the pious, who vividly feel that this benefit pertains unto them, are thence kindled with incredible love of God and most ardent study of piety. So Bernard, Epist. 107. Who is just except he who repays love unto God loving him? Which is not done, except the Spirit revealing through faith unto a man the everlasting purpose of God concerning his future salvation.
pass_b_english: Finally the praxis of all the saints cries out against Arminius. It is certain they were the more studious of piety and true obedience, the more certain they were of their election and everlasting life. Example: the holy Patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob; the most Blessed of women, the Mother of our Lord Jesus Christ; Peter, Paul, and the other Apostles. Nay, everyone who has this hope in himself sanctifies himself, as he is holy (1 John iii. 3). So profane men, who foolishly presume and idly chatter of their predestination, grow less careful about worshipping God. But pious hearts, who vividly feel this benefit belongs to them, are kindled with incredible love of God and most ardent study of piety. So Bernard (Epist. 107): Who is just but he who repays love to God who loves him? That is not done unless the Spirit reveals through faith to a man God's eternal purpose concerning his future salvation.
source_text: Denique reclamat Arminio omnium sanctorum praxis, quos certum est eo studiosiores fuisse pietatis et verae obedientiae, quo certiores fuerunt suae electionis et vitae aeternae. Exemplo esse possunt sancti Patriarchae, Abrahamus, Isaacus, Jacobus, Beatissima mulierum Mater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, Petrus, Paulus, reliquique Apostoli: Imo omnis qui habet hanc spem in seipso, sanctificat se, sicut ille sanctus est, 1 Joann. iii. 3. Profani igitur homines, qui stulte praesumere solent, et otiose garrire de sua praedestinatione, inde redduntur de Deo colendo minus soliciti: sed piorum pectora, qui vivide sentiunt hoc beneficium ad se pertinere, inde incenduntur incredibili amore Dei et ardentissimo studio pietatis. Sic Bernardus, Epist. 107. Justus quis est nisi qui amanti se Deo vicem rependit amoris? Quod non fit, nisi revelante Spiritu per fidem, homini aeternum Dei propositum super sua salute futura.
